title: ETERNAL FLAME 〜空の箱〜

zh: 在地图上找不到的三叉路口
现在正困在这里
我该依靠什么来继续前进呢？
所谓按教科书做事
只是充满了艰深的词汇
到今天，仍未改变一丝一毫
如果填补这个空白 就能解开答案吗
你会如何向前迈进呢？
显得异常空白 又显得异常漫长

我现在一筹莫展
即使逞强 结果也大概相同

en: Right now, at a crossroads that shouldn't be on any map
I've run straight into it
What am I supposed to follow to move on?
They say to just follow the textbook, and it's true, but
It's nothing but difficult words
Today still hasn't changed a bit from back then
If I fill in this blank, will it be solved someday?
How would you go about moving forward?
It's so white, and so endlessly long
The answers are mostly just form-shaped common sense
Even if my fingertips are trembling
There's no right answer, there's no such thing as losing
My whole life I'll be me, and that's all there is
Stir it up any more and there's no tomorrow
Blame it on a map that's useless
I'm at a total loss right now
Even if I act tough, the result is probably the same
If only this blank weren't here, you'd think so too
That it's fine to stay like this, that alone is wrong
It's so white, and so endlessly long
The answers are mostly just form-shaped common sense
Even if my fingertips are trembling
There's no right answer, there's no such thing as losing
My whole life I'll be me, and that's all there is
Stir it up any more and there's no tomorrow
It's empty, there isn't a single thing
I don't know if it vanished or just began, but
There's no other way but to go, right?
Who cares about right answers, there's no value in any of it
My whole life, I can't live as anyone but me
Stir it up any more and there's no tomorrow
No matter how I struggle, there's no tomorrow
